entries.description: Deal Check: five questions (customer, money, power, path, now) that separate proof from hopium in a federal deal.
representativeQueries: is my deal real or hopium
qualify a federal sales deal before commit
what will my manager ask about this deal

entries.description: Account Check: Five questions that tell you whether you know the account or only the opportunity in front of you: mission, money, power, incumbents, how they buy. One minute, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: do I know the account or just my contact
am I single-threaded in this account
federal account check

entries.description: Competition Check: Five questions that tell you whether the incumbent, the competitor, or doing nothing is beating you right now. One minute, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: why would they pick us over doing nothing
am I beating the incumbent
competitive position check for a deal

entries.description: Quota Check: Your quota against your on-target earnings, judged by what the number is measured in: new bookings, cloud consumption growth, or a whole book. Free, in your browser, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: is my quota crazy
quota to OTE ratio for cloud sales
is my sales quota fair

entries.description: Territory Check: Can the patch make the number, or are you being asked to grow where nobody could? Five questions for sellers. Nothing stored.
representativeQueries: can my territory make the number
is my sales territory viable
new patch sizing check

entries.description: Discount Check: They want a discount. See what it costs in your commission and the company's margin before you say yes. Free, in your browser, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: what does a discount cost me in commission
should I give a 15 percent discount
discount impact on margin and commission

entries.description: Commission Check: Deal size and commission rate in, what you actually take home out, after the share you set aside for taxes. Free, in your browser, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: how much of my commission do I take home
commission take home after taxes
commission check calculator

entries.description: Pipeline Check: target, pipeline and win rate in, the gap out. 3X is a rule of thumb; your win rate says what you actually need.
representativeQueries: do I have enough pipeline to make my number
pipeline coverage calculator with my win rate
is 3X pipeline coverage enough

entries.description: Risk Check: Coverage says whether you have enough pipeline. This says how fragile it is: concentration, aging, next steps, timing and creation. Five questions, one minute, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: how fragile is my pipeline
pipeline concentration and aging risk
4X coverage but still at risk

entries.description: Rep Check: Is it the rep, the patch, a skill gap or an effort gap? Five questions for sales managers. No names, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: is it the rep or the territory
why is my sales rep underperforming
rep problem or patch problem

entries.description: Partner Check: Five questions that separate a partner who sells with you from a logo on a slide. For partner managers. One minute, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: is this partner real or a logo
is my channel partner actually selling
partner check for co-sell

entries.description: OLR Check: Five questions that test the case you're making for a rep in OLR, then the room grills you. No names, no ratings, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: prepare for OLR calibration
will my case for a rep survive talent review
Amazon OLR prep for managers

entries.description: Brief Check: Five questions about the doc, deck or QBR you're about to present, then the room grills you. Nothing uploaded, nothing stored.
representativeQueries: will my QBR survive the room
pressure test my brief before the meeting
what question am I hoping nobody asks
